  <p style="margin-left:2.253%;text-indent:-0.015%;padding-left:0.013%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.241%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">For </font><font style="color:#1c1c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the purposes of these financial covenants, the following definitions and the definitions in the Property Conditions apply in addition to those set out in clause 1.3 </font><font style="color:#1c1c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">(Definitions).</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:2.2%;text-indent:-0.087%;padding-left:0.08%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.287%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1c1c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Calculation Date </font><font style="color:#1c1c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means the last day of each 12 month period until the Termination Date, commencing on the first Calculation Date of 30 June 2024.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:2.253%;text-indent:-0.085%;padding-left:0.08%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1c1c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Calculation Period </font><font style="color:#1c1c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means each period of twelve months ending on a Calculation Date, unless otherwise agreed in writing by NAB.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:2.253%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1c1c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">EBITDA </font><font style="color:#1c1c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means earnings before:</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:2.259%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.204%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1c1c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.3242753808534795%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1c1c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">interest;</font></div></div>

  <p style="margin-left:4.747%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">This important notice should be read and understood before the Borrower decides to enter into a Facility or transaction in a foreign currency.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:4.733%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">This notice is intended to provide the Borrower with a general warning of the risks that can arise from adverse exchange rate movements when transacting in a foreign currency, and to advise the Borrower that other risks also exist.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:4.796%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:2.935%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:3.082853661610857%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Dollar relative</font><font style="color:#575757;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">to the currency of the foreign currency facility or transaction; or</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:4.796%;display:flex;margin-top:0.95pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:2.935%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:3.082853661610857%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the foreign currency relative to the Dollar.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:4.773%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.5%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Another risk that may also exist is the potential for adverse movements in the interest rate that applies to the foreign currency Facility or transaction</font><font style="color:#3d3d3f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:4.733%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Borrower should also be aware that in some circumstances mechanisms may be available for limiting these risks. Such mechanisms may include products ranging from forward FX contracts (FECs) and fixed rate loans to more complex options and derivatives. A solution can be tailored to the Borrower's specific business needs.</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:3.731%;display:flex;margin-top:10.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:5.26129906823588%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.2</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Additional </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Conditions </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">Precedent</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:8.893%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The following additional conditions precedent apply in relation to any Drawing</font><font style="color:#3d3d3f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">:</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8.806%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.721933460534685%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Drawdown Date is a Banking Day within the Availability Period;</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.11in;min-height:1.25in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">47</font></p></div>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.935%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.796%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.447106860796217%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">subject to </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">contrary agreement, </font><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the currency </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">of </font><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Drawing </font><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">is the </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">same as </font><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">currency of the Loan Account; and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.806%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.13%;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.577676674464021%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	the </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Australian Dollar Equivalent of the Drawing does not exceed the Available Facility at </font><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">that </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">time unless NAB has given its prior written consent for an amount greater than the Available Facility to be drawn.</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:1.87%;display:flex;margin-top:9.95pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.161520432079895%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.3</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Drawing</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.92%;text-indent:-0.043%;padding-left:0.04%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Any amount paid or repaid to the credit of the Facility may be redrawn subject to the terms of this document.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:1.87%;display:flex;margin-top:9.9pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.161520432079895%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.4</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Repayment</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.973%;text-indent:-0.016%;padding-left:0.013%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.278%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB may require the Borrower to repay all or part of the Balance Owing at any time. The Borrower must repay all of the Balance Owing on demand.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:1.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.161520432079895%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.5</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Prepayment</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.933%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Borrower may prepay the whole or any part of the Balance Owing at any time.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:1.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.161520432079895%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.6</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Interest</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:7.065%;display:flex;margin-top:10.45pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.796%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.456125248829826%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Interest on debit balances is calculated daily by applying the Daily Interest Rate to the Value Balance (excluding any amount to which a Default Interest Rate applies) at the end of each day.</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:7.065%;display:flex;margin-top:10.2pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.456125248829826%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	The Value Balance is generally the same as the Balance Owing, except that interest charges for an Interest Period (including any interest adjustment) do not form part of the Value Balance until the first day of the next Interest Period (even though they may be </font><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">included in </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Balance Owing from the date they are debited).</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.456125248829826%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Interest for:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:13.204%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.667%;min-width:5.463%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.29406885109913%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">an Interest Period is debited from the Loan Account on the last Business Day of that Interest Period or such other reasonable times as NAB may notify; and</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:13.065%;display:flex;margin-top:10.3pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.443894863978835%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the last Interest Period is debited from the Loan Account on the Termination Date.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.7pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.333%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.456125248829826%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(d)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Where a transaction for a particular day is processed by NAB after that day, for whatever reason, NAB may, acting reasonably, elect to back-date that transaction and, if NAB does this, an appropriate interest adjustment will be made </font><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">to </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Loan Account on the last Banking Day of the next Interest Period.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.168367346938776%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.7</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">What </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">currency applies</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:7.074%;display:flex;margin-top:10.2pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:8.796%;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.59664679422336%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Borrower must ensure that all payments to the Facility are in the currency of the Loan Account.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.204%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.065%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.46579593948015%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Fees and charges are calculated in Dollars and may be debited by NAB from the Loan Account with any necessary currency conversions made in accordance with the provisions of the </font><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">'NAB </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Foreign Currency Account- Onshore Terms and Conditions' as amended or replaced from </font><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">time </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">to </font><font style="color:#2f2f2f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">time </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">in accordance with any notice given under any Finance Document.</font></div></div>

  <div style="margin-left:7.741%;display:flex;margin-top:10.35pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.644338221745304%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">A Drawdown Notice is irrevocable once given.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.87%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.512536633018561%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Notwithstanding any other provision, NAB can decline any request to draw on a Facility at its discretion and will advise the Borrower promptly if it does this.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:11.463%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.512536633018561%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	Any amount repaid or prepaid is available for redraw subject to the terms of this document.</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:2.806%;display:flex;margin-top:10.1pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#2d2d2d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.211227030475133%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">3.4</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#2d2d2d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Repayment</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.204%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.512536633018561%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Each Drawing made under a Facility is for an agreed term and the Balance Owing for each Drawing must be repaid in full at the end of the term of that Drawing.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:11.87%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.512536633018561%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Borrower must make such repayments as required for it to comply with the Amortisation Schedule (if any).	</font><font style="color:#4f4f4f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#149;</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:2.806%;display:flex;margin-top:10.3pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.211227030475133%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">3.5</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Prepayment</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:7.867%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Borrower may prepay all or part of the Balance Owing in respect of:</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.521739130434782%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">an Overseas Currency Loan Facility:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:14%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4%;min-width:5.463%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.352325581395349%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	on the last day of an Interest Period provided that the Borrower gives NAB at least 5 Banking Days prior written notice of its request and pays to NAB any applicable fees; or</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:14%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.537%;min-width:5.463%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.352325581395349%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">at any other time, if NAB agrees in writing that the Borrower may make such prepayment and provided that it pays NAB all Economic Costs (if any) and any other applicable fees; and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.065%;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.65364159340063%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">any Facility other than an Overseas Currency Loan Facility, </font><font style="color:#2d2d2d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">if </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB agrees in writing </font><font style="color:#2d2d2d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">that </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Borrower may make a prepayment (NAB's agreement of which shall not to be unreasonably withheld). No Economic Costs will be applicable.</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:2.806%;display:flex;margin-top:9.75pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.211227030475133%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">3.6</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Interest</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:8%;display:flex;margin-top:10.6pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.204%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.521739130434782%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Interest </font><font style="color:#2d2d2d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">is </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">calculated daily on the Balance Owing in respect of a Drawing (excluding any amount to which a Default Interest Rate applies) at the end of that day using the Daily Interest Rate.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.521739130434782%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">If </font><font style="color:#2d2d2d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Details provide that interest is payable in arrears:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:14.139%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.463%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.362609333690499%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">all accrued interest is payable:</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:19.602%;display:flex;margin-top:10.3pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6%;min-width:4.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.13694370506729%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(A)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">in respect of a Drawing under an Overseas Currency Loan Facility, on the last day of each Interest Period for that Drawing; and</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.11in;min-height:1.24in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:10.65pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">37</font></p></div>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:15.463%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.626684173793723%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">all accrued but unpaid interest is payable on the Termination Date.</font></div></div>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:15.463%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.333%;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.626684173793723%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">in respect of a Drawing under an Overseas Currency Loan Facility, on the first day of each Interest Period for that Drawing; and</font></div></div>

  <p style="margin-left:21.107%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the first Banking Day of that term.</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.537%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.333%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.419652696789105%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">for any other Facility, the Borrower authorises NAB to debit to the Nominated Account any amounts payable by the Borrower in relation to the Facility, including interest, fees and charges, taxes, enforcement expenses and any amount payable under an indemnity. Where the currency of the Nominated Account </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(Account Currency) </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">is not in the currency of the amount payable by the Borrower </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(Other Currency), </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB may notionally convert the Other Currency at its prevailing spot rate of exchange against the Account Currency for the debit.</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:1.333%;display:flex;margin-top:10.2pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.133428603281747%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">6.</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">FOREIGN CURRENCY FACILITIES OR </font><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">TRANSACTIONS</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:1.333%;display:flex;margin-top:9.75pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.133428603281747%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">6.1</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Application </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">of </font><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">this clause</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.493%;text-indent:-0.015%;padding-left:0.013%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.38%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">This clause 6 </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">(Foreign Currency Facilities or Transactions) </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">applies to any Facility made available in or which involves foreign currencies.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:1.472%;display:flex;margin-top:10.1pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.1406706722962%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">6.2</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Funding risk and non-availability</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:6.537%;display:flex;margin-top:10.2pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.333%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.419652696789105%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB will use its best efforts to notify the Borrower as soon as practicable if the making, denomination or continuation of the Facility in the foreign currency is not reasonably practicable or is impossible as a result of:</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.11in;min-height:1.24in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:15.95pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">39</font></p></div>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:8.95pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:13.731%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.065%;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.4936419803173795%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">any change </font><font style="color:#313131;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">in </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">national or international financial, political or economic conditions</font><font style="color:#5b5b5b;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">, </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">currency exchange rates, currency availability or exchange controls;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:13.731%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.935%;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.4936419803173795%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">any event of contingency which materially and adversely affects the inter-bank markets generally; or</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:13.731%;display:flex;margin-top:10.2pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.4936419803173795%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(iii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">any change in law.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.602%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:10%;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.634342734691227%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">During the 30 days after that notice is given by NAB, NAB will negotiate with the Borrower in good faith to find an alternative basis to continue the affected Facility.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.731%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.502725725866759%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	If no agreement is reached within the 30 day period referred to in clause 6.2(b), the affected Facility terminates automatically and the Borrower must immediately repay in full the Amount Owing in respect of that Facility (including providing cash </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">cover </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">on terms satisfactory to NAB for an amount not less than the </font><font style="color:#313131;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Maximum </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Liability under each outstanding Letter of Credit in the currency in which such Letter of Credit is denominated).</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:2.528%;display:flex;margin-top:9.9pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.204%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.338969139855549%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">6.3</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Currency Indemnity</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:7.741%;display:flex;margin-top:10.6pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.13%;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.644338221745304%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	Clause 6.3(b) applies if a judgment or order is given by any court or tribunal for the payment of any amount owing by the Borrower under the Facility, or for the payment of damages by the Borrower in respect of any breach of the terms of the Facility, where that judgment or order is expressed in a currency </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(Judgment Currency) </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">which is different from the currency expressed to be payable under this document in relation. to the Facility </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(Relevant Foreign Currency).</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:7.741%;display:flex;margin-top:10.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.87%;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.644338221745304%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Borrower indemnifies NAB against any deficiency in the amounts received by NAB arising or resulting from any variation between:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:13.731%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.269%;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.4936419803173795%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	the rate of exchange at which the Relevant Foreign Currency is converted into the Judgment Currency for the purpose of the judgment or order; and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:13.731%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:8.537%;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.4936419803173795%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the rate of exchange at which NAB is able to purchase the Relevant Foreign Currency with the Judgment Currency at the time of its receipt by NAB.</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:2.528%;display:flex;margin-top:9.65pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.204%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#313131;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.338969139855549%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">6.4</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#313131;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">No </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">advice or </font><font style="color:#313131;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">management </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">by </font><font style="color:#313131;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:7.68%;text-indent:-0.015%;padding-left:0.013%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Borrower acknowledges and agrees that NAB does not, and the Borrower must not rely on NAB to, manage, supervise or advise the Borrower in relation to the Borrower's foreign currency exposure.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.537%;display:flex;margin-top:9.5pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.196843930517223%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">6.5</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Foreign </font><font style="color:#313131;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">currency </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">fluctuations</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:7.707%;text-indent:0.045%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">If a Facility </font><font style="color:#313131;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">is </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">made available or involves a foreign currency and there is a change in the exchange rate applicable between that foreign currency and Dollars which has the effect of causing the Australian Dollar Equivalent of the Balance Owing to exceed the Australian Dollar Equivalent of the Facility Limit, NAB may require the Borrower to either:</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.731%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.333%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.502725725866759%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	repay a sufficient amount to NAB so that the Australian Dollar Equivalent of the Balance Owing under the Facility is equal to or less than the Australian Dollar Equivalent of the Facility Limit; or</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.741%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.537%;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.644338221745304%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">provide additional Encumbrances acceptable to NAB to the value determined by NAB, but not less than the amount payable under clause 6.5(a).</font></div></div>

  <div style="margin-left:3.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.204%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.368545932841594%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">7.</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">GENERAL PAYMENT OBLIGATIONS</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:8.227%;text-indent:-0.015%;padding-left:0.013%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.407%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">To the extent not otherwise payable, the Borrower must repay to NAB all of the Amount Owing on the Termination Date.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:3.204%;display:flex;margin-top:9.6pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.065%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.232654241910823%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">8.</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">DEFINITIONS</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:8.253%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">For the purposes of these Global Trade Finance Specific Conditions:</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:8.173%;text-indent:-0.075%;padding-left:0.067%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.407%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Approved Currency </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means the currency or currencies approved by NAB in writing from time to time.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:8.227%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Australian Dollar Equivalent </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in respect of</font><font style="color:#505050;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">:</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8.269%;display:flex;margin-top:10.55pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.269%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.54086404814076%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Facility Limit for a Facility at any time which is expressed in a foreign currency, the equivalent amount in Australian Dollars (when notionally converted by NAB at the rate of exchange used by NAB for the purpose, and at the time, of approving the Facility); and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.87%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.54086404814076%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Balance Owing for, or any other amount in respect of, a Facility which is expressed in a foreign currency, the equivalent amount of the Balance Owing or other amount in Australian Dollars (as notionally converted by NAB at its prevailing spot rate of exchange).</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:8.253%;text-indent:-0.076%;padding-left:0.067%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.5%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Available Facility </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in respect of a Facility at any time, the Australian Dollar Equivalent of the Facility Limit minus the Australian Dollar Equivalent of the Balance Owing at that time.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:8.253%;text-indent:-0.102%;padding-left:0.093%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Availability Period </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in respect of a Facility, the period from the date of this document to the Expiry Date.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:8.253%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Banking Day </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means a day other than</font><font style="color:#505050;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">;</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.5500753258662465%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">a Saturday or Sunday;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.5500753258662465%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">a public holiday in Sydney or the capital city where your transaction will be processed; or</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.463%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.5500753258662465%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">for any currency other than Australian Dollars, a public holiday in the principal financial centre of the currency involved in the transaction or in the principal financial centre for US currency.</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:8.347%;text-indent:-0.015%;padding-left:0.013%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.407%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">BBSY </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means the rate determined by NAB which </font><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">is </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">equal to the higher of zero and the &#34;bid rate&#34; administered by ASX Benchmarks displayed on page BBSY of the Thomson Reuters Screen on the first day of that Pricing Period for a period equal to that Pricing Period (or where the Pricing Period is less than 1 month, a period of 1 month) and which starts on that day. If such rate is not available or if, in NAB's reasonable opinion, the rate becomes inappropriate, the Floating Rate will be the rate reasonably determined by NAB to be the appropriate equivalent rate, having regard to the prevailing market.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:8.347%;text-indent:-0.079%;padding-left:0.067%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.241%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Beneficiary </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in relation to a Standby Letter of Credit, the person to whom the Standby Letter of Credit </font><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">is </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">to be, or has already been, issued and any assignee of such person.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:8.4%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Cut-Off Time </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means:</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8.398%;display:flex;margin-top:10.1pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.269%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.5500753258662465%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	in respect of a Drawdown under an Overseas Currency Loan Facility, 2 Banking Days prior to the proposed Drawdown Date; and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.602%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.5500753258662465%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	in respect of a Drawing under any other Facility, the period prior to the proposed Drawdown Date as determined by NAB from time to time which is subject to change without notice and which can be notified to the Borrower upon request.</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.11in;min-height:1.31in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:15.95pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">41</font></p></div>

  <p style="margin-left:7.707%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Issue Date </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means the date on which a Letter of Credit is issued or to be issued.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.64%;text-indent:-0.09%;padding-left:0.08%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.95pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Letter </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">of </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Credit </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means a documentary letter of credit or a standby letter of credit issued by NAB pursuant to a Facility.</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:7.693%;text-indent:-0.046%;padding-left:0.04%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.5%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Maximum </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Liability </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in respect of a Letter of Credit, the amount specified in that Letter of Credit as the maximum liability (exclusive of interest on that maximum liability) under that Letter of Credit.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.733%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Utilisation </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means the issue of a Letter of Credit by NAB at the Borrower's request.</font></p>
