  <div style="margin-left:14.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.204%;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.544239620569613%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(iv)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	part of the Range Amount, the Interest Rate for a Pricing Period is the Range Rate.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.204%;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.682582769183809%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Provided no Default is continuing, the Interest Rate that applies to a Corporate Markets Loan Component for a Pricing Period remains constant during the term of that Pricing Period, whether or not further Drawings or repayments are made.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:14.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.398%;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.544239620569613%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	will be the weighted average of the interest rates applicable to each Corporate Markets Loan Component for that Pricing Period;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:14.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.731%;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.544239620569613%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(iii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	will be recalculated by NAB and may change for the remainder of a Pricing Period if repayments or further Drawings are made during that Pricing Period.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.5500753258662465%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(d)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Generally, the Interest Rates, as a percentage rate, applicable to a Facility will be set out in the Drawdown Schedule. Where a percentage rate is not set out in the Drawdown Schedule for an applicable .Interest Rate or where the percentage rate is stated to be 'indicative only', the Interest Rate will be the rate NAB advises as determined by NAB on or before the day the first Drawing is made under the Facility.</font></div></div>

  <p style="margin-left:7.507%;text-indent:-0.077%;padding-left:0.067%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.38%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Availability Peri</font><font style="color:#3b3b3b;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">od </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in respect of the Facility, the period from the date of this document to the Termination Date.</font></p>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.1in;min-height:1.22in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>

  <p style="margin-left:7.907%;text-indent:-0.06%;padding-left:0.053%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Available Facility </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, </font><font style="color:#444444;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">in </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">respect </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">of </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the </font><font style="color:#444444;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Facility </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">at any </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">time, </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Facility Limit less </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Balance Owing at that time. &#149;</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:7.907%;text-indent:-0.079%;padding-left:0.067%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.278%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Banking Day </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday, or a day gazette as a public holiday in Sydney or every state and territory of Australia.</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:8%;display:flex;margin-top:10.35pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.333%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.521739130434782%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the rate determined by NAB which is equal to the higher of zero and the &#34;bid rate&#34; administered by ASX Benchmarks displayed on page BBSY of the Thomson Reuters Screen on the first day of that Pricing Period for a period equal to that Pricing Period (or where the Pricing Period is less than 1 month, a period of 1 month) and which starts on that day; or</font></div></div>

  <p style="margin-left:8%;text-indent:-0.046%;padding-left:0.04%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.5%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Cap Amount </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means the part of the Facility that is subject to either a Cap Rate or the Floating Rate, depending on their value, as determined in accordance with this document.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:8%;text-indent:-0.047%;padding-left:0.04%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.944%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Cap </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Rate </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in respect of each Cap Rate Corporate Markets Loan Component, the Cap Rate specified in the relevant Drawdown Schedule or as otherwise determined in accordance with this document.</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:7.947%;text-indent:-0.046%;padding-left:0.04%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.38%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Floor </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Rate </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in respect of the Range Rate Corporate Markets Loan Component, the Floor Rate specified in the relevant Drawdown Schedule or as otherwise determined in accordance with this document.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.947%;text-indent:-0.03%;padding-left:0.027%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Funding </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Margin </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in relation to the Facility, the funding margin specified in the Details for that Facility or as otherwise agreed.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.947%;text-indent:-0.091%;padding-left:0.08%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.5%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Last </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Date </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">for Initial Drawdown </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means the date listed as the last date for initial drawdown (if any) in the Details (as amended from time to time).</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.96%;text-indent:-0.091%;padding-left:0.08%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.5%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Maturity Date </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means the date on which a Fixed Rate Period or Range Rate Period is due to expire.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.96%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Premium </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means the &#34;Cap/Range Rate Premium&#34; specified in the Details.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.947%;text-indent:-0.045%;padding-left:0.04%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Pricing Period </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means a period determined in accordance with the Details and clause 5.1, as adjusted in accordance with clauses 5.1(c) and (d).</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.96%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Range </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Amount </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means the part of a Facility that is subject to a Range Rate.</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:7.87%;display:flex;margin-top:10.35pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:8.796%;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.65364159340063%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the relevant Floor Rate, if the Floating Rate prevailing on the first day of the Pricing Period is less than the Floor Rate; or</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.13%;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.663043478260869%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#149;  </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the relevant Cap Rate, if the Floating Rate prevailing on the first day of the Pricing Period is greater than the Cap Rate; or</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:6.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.65364159340063%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Floating Rate, in any other case.</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:7.893%;text-indent:-0.061%;padding-left:0.053%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.5%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Range Rate </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Period </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in relation to a Drawing that has been allocated to the Range Amount, the period during which the Range Rate applies to that Drawing.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.893%;text-indent:-0.045%;padding-left:0.04%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.472%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Reset Margin </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in relation to a Facility, the reset margin (if any) determined in accordance with clause 9.3.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.907%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Undrawn Fee </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means, in relation to a Facility, the undrawn fee (if any) specified in the Details.</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:2.528%;display:flex;margin-top:10.3pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.204%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.338969139855549%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">3.2</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Cancellation</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:7.87%;display:flex;margin-top:9.9pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.537%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.512536633018561%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Facility can be cancelled or the Facility Limit reduced by NAB or the Borrower at any time, even </font><font style="color:#333131;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">if </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">it has an </font><font style="color:#333131;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Expiry </font><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Date and even if this means the new Facility Limit is lower than the Balance Owing.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.512536633018561%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Facility Limit automatically reduces by the amount of any cancellation or reduction.</font></div></div>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:8%;display:flex;margin-top:9.85pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.521739130434782%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Unless otherwise provided, interest for each day is calculated by applying the Daily Interest Rate to the Balance Owing at the end of that day (excluding any amount to which a Default Interest Rate applies).</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:8%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:8%;min-width:6%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.521739130434782%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Where tiered interest rates apply (see Details), clause 4.2(a) does not apply and the interest for each day is the aggregate of:</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:14%;display:flex;margin-top:10.3pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.463%;min-width:5.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.513953488372094%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1d1d1d;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Daily Interest Rate for Tier One, multiplied by that part of the Balance Owing at the end of that day that falls within Tier One; and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.12in;min-height:1.25in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:2.7pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">67</font></p></div>

  <div style="margin-left:6.935%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.2980712405308115%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">advertised by NAB in the local or national press.</font></div></div>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>

  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.1in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">114</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>

  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <div style="margin-left:9.87%;display:flex;margin-top:4.75pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.13%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.438033950959725%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the provisions in this document relating to set-off will prevail.</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:2%;display:flex;margin-top:9.45pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9489795918367347%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.6</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Personal Property Securities (PPS) law</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:10.35pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.25531914893617%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">If:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:9.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.667%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.438033950959725%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">a PPS Law applies, or will at a future date apply to any of the Finance Documents or any of the transactions contemplated by them, or NAB determines that a PPS Law applies, or will at a future date apply, to any of the Finance Documents or any of the transactions contemplated by them; and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.731%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.444444444444445%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">in the opinion of NAB (acting reasonably), the PPS Law:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.95pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:14%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.537%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.5%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(A)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">adversely affects or would adversely affect NAB's security position or the rights or obligations of NAB under or in connection with the Finance Documents; or</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:14%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.602%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.651162790697675%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(B)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">enables or would enable NAB's security position to be improved without adversely affecting the Obligors in a material respect,</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:14.067%;text-indent:-0.016%;padding-left:0.013%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.093%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB may give notice to the Obligors requiring the Obligors to do anything (including amending any Finance Document or executing any new Finance Document) that in NAB's opinion is reasonably necessary to ensure that, to the maximum possible extent, NAB's security position, and rights and obligations, are not adversely affected as contemplated by clause (A) (or that any such adverse effect is overcome), or that NAB's security position is improved as contemplated in clause (B) and the Borrowers must comply with the requirements of that notice within the time stipulated in the notice.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.333%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.267531553061421%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">In this clause 1.6 </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">(Personal Property Securities (PPS} law), </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">PPS </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Law </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">means:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.457768218341488%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Personal Property Securities Act 2009 (Cth) </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(PPS Act);</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:9.731%;display:flex;margin-top:4.75pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.935%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.287186077169349%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#xe;</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.1in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">115</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>

  <div style="margin-left:9.731%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.333%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.287186077169349%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(iii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">any provision of the PPS Act or regulations referred to in clause </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(ii);</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:9.731%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:9.87%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.287186077169349%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(iv)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">any amendment to any of the above, made at any time; or</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:9.731%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.796%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.287186077169349%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(v)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">any amendment made at any time to any other legislation as a consequence of a PPS Law referred to in clauses (i) to (iv).</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:1.861%;display:flex;margin-top:9.75pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:3.943386421300401%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">2.1</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Facilities</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:5.853%;text-indent:-0.045%;padding-left:0.04%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:9.95pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.546%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Each Facility is made available during its Availability Period on the terms set out in this document.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2%;display:flex;margin-top:9.7pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:3.9489795918367347%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">2.2</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Purpose and monitoring</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:5.893%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.546%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Borrower must apply all Drawings under a Facility for the purpose specified for that Facility in the relevant Details or for any other purpose that NAB approves in writing. NAB is not bound to monitor or verify the application of any Drawings.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:3.9489795918367347%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">3.</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">CONDITIONS PRECEDENT</font></div></div>

  <div style="margin-left:6.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.398%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.1345270400205125%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">such further information regarding the financial condition, business and operations of any Obligor as </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">may reasonably request; and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.537%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.1345270400205125%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(iii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">all material notices received by any Obligor from any Agency and, if listed on any securities exchange, all notices issued by, or given to, the relevant securities exchange, regarding matters which could have a Material Adverse Effect;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:22.537%;min-width:4%;text-align:right;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(Authorisations):</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.731%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.1345270400205125%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">obtain, renew on time, comply with and do all that is necessary to</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.12in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">106</font></p></div>

  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="margin-left:14.827%;text-indent:0.016%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.093%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">maintain in full force and effect any Material Authorisation; and</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.796%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.484103851845209%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">not do anything which would prevent the prompt renewal of any Authorisation or cause it to be renewed on less favorable terms;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.935%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.269%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.2980712405308115%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(d)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(comply with laws) </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">comply with all laws to which it or its assets are subject;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.13%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.164200785495238%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(e)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(change of business) </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">ensure, and procure that, no significant change is made to the general nature of the business of any Obligor from that carried on at the date of this document;</font></div></div>

  <div style="margin-left:7.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.796%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.164200785495238%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(g)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(acquisition subject </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">to </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Encumbrance) </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">except with the prior written consent of NAB, not acquire any asset which is subject to an Encumbrance or which becomes the subject of an Encumbrance on its acquisition;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.87%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.304083499219884%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(h)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(disposals) </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">not enter into a single transaction or a series of transactions (whether related or not and whether voluntary or involuntary) to sell, lease, license, transfer, grant an interest over, part with possession of or otherwise dispose of any asset or any interest in any asset other than a Permitted Disposal;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:11.065%;display:flex;margin-top:10.45pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.497666835329173%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">take out and maintain insurances with an independent and reputable insurer in the manner and to the extent stipulated by NAB or, if not stipulated by NAB, for the amounts and against risks which are in accordance with prudent business practice having regard to the nature of the business, assets and operations of the Obligors (including all insurances required by applicable law);</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:9.861%;display:flex;margin-top:4.95pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.398%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.293369129899378%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#xe;</font></div></div>

  <div style="margin-left:10.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.457768218341488%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">control the membership of the board of directors,</font></div></div>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:5.87%;display:flex;margin-top:10.45pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.796%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.249442260703283%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Following a Pricing Review, NAB may, by giving written notice (including by way of revised terms and conditions for any Facility or by way of a revised Fees Guide) to the Borrowers and/or by way of publication on NAB's website and/or advertisement in the local or national press:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

The Borrower must pay to NAB immediately on demand any amount so debited.</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:3.194%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9976860938371597%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">14.4</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Review Event</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:7.093%;text-indent:0.014%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.722%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Each Borrower must promptly notify NAB after it becomes aware that a Review Event has occurred.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:3.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.1264765048744%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">14.5</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Review Event Consequences</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.304083499219884%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	Following the occurrence of a Review Event, the Obligors and NAB must enter into negotiations for a period of not less than the Negotiation Period, with a view to agreeing terms on which NAB would be prepared to offer to provide, fund or maintain all </font><font style="color:#626262;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">_</font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">or any of the Facilities.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:7.04%;text-indent:-4.465%;padding-left:3.96%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.306%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(b} If agreement is reached, the Obligors must do all acts and execute all documents as NAB requires to document, or to protect, preserve or secure NAB's rights and interests under, such agreement.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:5pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.463%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.117021276595745%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#xe;</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.1in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f21;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">102</font></p></div>

  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:5pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.463%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.117021276595745%;visibility:hidden;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;"></font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	If agreement is not reached within the Negotiation Period or if (in the opinion of NAB) any of the Obligors does not do all acts and execute all documents as NAB requires to document, or to protect, preserve or secure for NAB's rights and </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">interests </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">under, any agreement, NAB may by giving written notice to the Borrowers:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:9.893%;text-indent:-4.744%;padding-left:3.853%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.028%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(ii}		declare that all or any part of the Amount Owing is due and payable whereupon it will be due and payable within the Mandatory Prepayment Period.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:5.92%;text-indent:-4.536%;padding-left:3.92%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.741%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(d}		If the Borrowers fail to prepay all amounts payable under clause (c) within the Mandatory Prepayment Period, that failure will constitute an Event of Default and NAB may exercise any of its rights set out in clause 11.2 (</font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;font-style:italic;min-width:fit-content;">Consequences of an Event of Default)</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:5.867%;text-indent:0.059%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.509%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">If any Facility is terminated or cancelled in full or in part or if any part of the Balance Owing </font><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">in </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">respect of any Facility is permanently prepaid or repaid or if any part of the Balance Owing in respect of any Facility becomes repayable before its stated maturity date for any reason and if at that time there are any treasury</font><font style="color:#4f4f4f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">related transactions in existence between NAB and any Borrower </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(Open Positions) </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">then:</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <div style="margin-left:10.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.204%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.457768218341488%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(iii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">a reduction of any amount due and payable under any Finance Document,</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:10.347%;text-indent:-0.045%;padding-left:0.04%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.963%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">which is incurred or suffered by NAB or any of its Affiliates to the extent attributable to NAB or any of its Affiliates funding or performing its obligations under any Finance Document.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.269%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.273412961261512%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Clause (a) does not apply to the extent any Increased Costs are compensated by the relevant Borrower under clause 18(c).</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.528%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9703709783322396%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">21.</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">ECONOMIC COSTS</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:2.528%;display:flex;margin-top:9.5pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9703709783322396%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">21.1</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">When </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Economic Costs are payable</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:0.72%;text-indent:-0.041%;padding-left:0.04%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:2.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.546%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">WARNING: </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Economic Costs can be high and may increase the amount owed. Borrowers can ask NAB at any time for an estimate of Economic Costs.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.204%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.273412961261512%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Economic Costs are potentially payable by the Borrowers for a Facility whenever an Economic Event occurs in relation to that Facility.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.667%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.146443380154929%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	NAB will determine the amount of any Economic Costs payable in respect of the occurrence of an Economic Event and will</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:9.68%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.731%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#xe;</font></p>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.21in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f21;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">107</font></p></div>
