  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="margin-left:9.68%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.731%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">notify the relevant Borrowers of the amount (if any) that is payable by them in accordance with NAB's calculation under clause 21.3. Borrowers must pay NAB the amount of any Economic Costs notified to them by NAB as payable by them under this clause 21. Borrowers must pay those notified Economic Costs immediately following their receipt of the notification of the Economic Costs payable.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:1.861%;display:flex;margin-top:9.65pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.943386421300401%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">21.2</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Economic Events</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:5.773%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.389%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">An Economic Event is taken to have occurred if, at any time while a Yield Rate or an Interest Rate (other than a variable Interest Rate) applies to a Facility, a Facility Component, a Loan Account or a Drawing:</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:5.861%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.333%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.110942329958891%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	all or part of that Facility, Facility Component, Loan Account or Drawing is repaid early (even if NAB agrees to the early repayment being made};</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:5.731%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.065%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.243176441884394%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	that Facility, Facility Component, Loan Account or Drawing is re-priced by agreement from one fixed rate to another fixed rate or to another type of rate (such as a variable rate);</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:5.861%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.537%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.110942329958891%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">that Facility or a relevant Facility Limit or Component Limit is cancelled, reduced or not fully drawn for any reason at any time before the Expiry Date;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:5.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.667%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.249442260703283%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(d)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB is for any reason no longer obliged to accept, discount or endorse Bills under the Facility or a Bill is cancelled before its Maturity Date; or</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.13%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.117021276595745%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(e)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">if the Amount Owing becomes immediately due and payable following an Event of Default, or the Balance Owing otherwise becomes repayable, and NAB elects to treat it as an Economic Event;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:5.907%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">except to the extent that this occurs:</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:5.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.667%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.249442260703283%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(f)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">for a Facility other than a Bill Facility, NAB Business Markets Facility or NAB Corporate Markets Loan - on the Repricing Date applicable to the Facility or Loan Account (as the case may be), or if that day is not a Business Day, on the next Business Day;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:5.87%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.204%;min-width:4%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.249442260703283%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(g)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">for a Bill Facility, NAB Business Markets Facility or NAB Corporate Markets Loan, in relation to the Floating Amount;&#149;</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.21in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f21;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">108</font></p></div>

  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.787%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(h}  on the Expiry Date; or</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.667%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.731%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.2857295918914%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">in order to comply with the Amortisation Schedule (if any).</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.796%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.981317641249332%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">21.3</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">H</font><font style="color:#38383a;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">owNAB ca</font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">l</font><font style="color:#38383a;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">cu</font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">lates Economic Costs</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.733%;text-indent:0.029%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.13%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB will determine Economic Costs by calculating a reasonable estimate of the Costs and losses incurred, or expected to be incurred, by NAB (including fees, charges and premiums) in connection with an Economic Event. The calculation of Economic Costs may incorporate the following:</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.95pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.667%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.13%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.2857295918914%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	in relation to a Facility other than a Bill Facility, NAB Business Markets Facility or NAB Corporate Markets Loan, Costs, representing the difference between NAB's cost of funds at the start of the relevant Fixed Rate Period or Pricing Period and NAB's cost of funds at the date of the Economic Event over the remainder of that period. This is then discounted back to the net present value at the rate equivalent to NAB's cost of funds at that date;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.65pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.537%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.398%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.27976846452607%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">guarantees to NAB punctual performance by each Obligor of all that Obligor's obligations under the Finance Documents;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:2.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.537%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.27976846452607%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">undertakes with NAB that:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.528%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.667%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.325375536480688%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	whenever an Obligor does not pay any amount when due under or in &#149; connection with any Finance Document (or anything which would have been due if the Finance </font><font style="color:#505052;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#149; </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Document or the amount was enforceable, valid and not illegal), immediately on demand by NAB that Cross-Guarantor shall pay that</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:13.8%;text-indent:-0.017%;padding-left:0.013%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.093%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#xe;</font></p>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.12in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f21;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">112</font></p></div>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="margin-left:13.8%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.093%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">amount as if it was the principal obligor; and</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:9.861%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.293369129899378%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">if an Ipso Facto Event has occurred then that Cross-Guarantor shall immediately on demand by NAB pay all Drawings, accrued interest and Amount Owing as if it was the principal obligor; and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.269%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.117021276595745%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">indemnifies NAB immediately on demand against any cost, loss or liability suffered by NAB if any obligation guaranteed by it (or anything which would have been an obligation guaranteed by it if not unenforceable, invalid or illegal) is or becomes unenforceable, invalid or illegal. The amount of the cost, loss or liability shall be equal to the amount which NAB would otherwise have been entitled to recover.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:5.88%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.944%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Each of paragraphs (a), (b)(i), (b)(ii) and (c) is a separate obligation. None is limited by reference to the other.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:1.861%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.943386421300401%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">27.2</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Continuing guarantee</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:5.84%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.333%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">This guarantee, undertaking and indemnity is a continuing guarantee, undertaking and indemnity and will extend&deg; to the ultimate </font><font style="color:#363638;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">. </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">balance of sums payable by any Obligor under the Finance Documents, regardless of any intermediate payment or discharge in whole or in part.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:1.861%;display:flex;margin-top:9.5pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.943386421300401%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">27.3</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Reinstatement</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:5.84%;text-indent:0.044%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.944%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">If any payment to or any discharge, release or arrangement given or entered into by NAB (whether in respect of the obligations of any Obliger or any security for those obligations or otherwise) is avoided or reduced for any reason (including as a result of insolvency, breach of fiduciary or statutory duties or any similar event):</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:5.861%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.796%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.110942329958891%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the liability of each Obligor shall continue and any such security shall be reinstated as if the payment, discharge, avoidance or reduction had not occurred; and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:5.861%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.602%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.110942329958891%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	NAB is entitled to recover the value or amount of that security or payment from each Obliger as if the payment, discharge, avoidance or reduction had not occurred.</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.12in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f21;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">113</font></p></div>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <div style="margin-left:2.926%;display:flex;margin-top:4.7pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9866493602818474%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">27.4</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Waiver </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">of defenses</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.813%;text-indent:0.029%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.185%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The obligations of each Cross-Guarantor under this clause will not be affected by an act, omission, matter or thing which, but for this clause, would reduce, release or prejudice any of its obligations under this clause (without limitation and whether or not known to it or </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:8pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB) </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">including:</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.926%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.602%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.15798182091669%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	any time, waiver or other concession or consent granted to, or composition with, any Obliger or other person;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.796%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:2.935%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.29166130209004%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the release or resignation of any other Obliger or any other person;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.926%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.537%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.15798182091669%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">any composition or arrangement with any creditor of any Obliger or other person;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.926%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.15798182091669%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(d)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the taking, variation, compromise, exchange, renewal or release of, or refusal or neglect to perfect, execute, take up or enforce, any rights against, or security over assets of, any Obliger or other person or any non-presentation or non-observance of any formality or other requirement in respect of any instrument or any failure to realize the full value of any security;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.935%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.164200785495238%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(e)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	any incapacity or lack of power, authority or legal personality of or dissolution or change in the members or status of an Obliger or any other person;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.935%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.204%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.2980712405308115%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(f)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">any amendment, novation, supplement, extension, reinstatement or replacement of a Finance Document or any other document or security (however fundamental and whether or not more onerous) including any change in the purpose of, any extension of or any increase in any facility or the addition of any new facility under any Finance Document;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.935%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.398%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.2980712405308115%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(g)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">any unenforceability, illegality or invalidity of any obligation of any person under any Finance Document or any other document or security;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:7.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:2.269%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.164200785495238%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(h)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	any set off, combination of accounts or counterclaim;</font></div></div>

  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <div style="margin-left:2.13%;display:flex;margin-top:4.7pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9542249923367736%;visibility:hidden;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;"></font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">POWER OF ATTORNEY</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.25531914893617%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Each Obligor (for consideration received) irrevocably appoints NAB and each authorised officer or Controller appointed by NAB (each an </font><font style="color:#343436;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Attorney) </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">severally as its attorney for the purposes set out in clause (b).</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.13%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.25531914893617%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">In addition to doing anything which in the reasonable opinion of an Attorney is necessary or expedient for securing or perfecting this document and any Encumbrance created under a Security Document at anytime, the Attorney may, after the occurrence of an Event of Default, do any of the following:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.667%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.300000000000001%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">execute and deliver all documents: and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.85pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.300000000000001%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">do all things,</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:9.973%;text-indent:0.016%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.537%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">which are necessary or desirable to give effect to each Finance Document or a transaction contemplated by a Finance Document.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.13%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.269%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.1227229146692235%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(c)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	The Attorney may for the purposes of clause (b), appoint or remove any</font><font style="color:#4f4f4f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">' </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">substitute or delegate or sub-attorney.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:5.204%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.25531914893617%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(d)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Each Obligor agrees to ratify anything done by its Attorney for the purposes of clause (b).</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.13%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:7.87%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#363636;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9542249923367736%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">29.</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">ASSIGNMENT </font><font style="color:#343436;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">AND </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">CHANGES TO THE OBLIGORS</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:2%;display:flex;margin-top:9.7pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9489795918367347%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">29.1</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Assignments and </font><font style="color:#343436;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">transfers </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">by </font><font style="color:#343436;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.13%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.117021276595745%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	NAB may assign any of its rights or novate, sub-participate, sell-down or transfer by whatever form or otherwise deal with any or all of its rights and obligations under any Finance Document without the consent of, or notice to, any Obligor.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.7pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.463%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.117021276595745%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">In order to facilitate any such dealing, NAB may (but is not obliged to), from time to time, separate and sever any of its rights (or any part of any of its rights) described in a notice given by NAB to the Obligors from its other rights and obligations under any Finance Document.</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.12in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f21;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">117</font></p></div>

  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="margin-left:10.133%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Any such notice is effective from the time of delivery so that</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.13%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.667%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.450873483921219%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the rights and obligations described in the notice are independent from, and may be assigned (including at law), novated, sub-participated, sold-down, transferred or otherwise</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:14.08%;text-indent:0.016%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">dealt with separately from, any other rights and obligations of NAB under that Finance Document;</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.13%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.537%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.450873483921219%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the rights and obligations described in the notice may be exercised differently from any other rights and obligations of NAB under that Finance Document; and</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.13%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:2%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.450873483921219%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(iii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">the Amount Owing in respect of those rights may be calculated separately from the other Amount Owing.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.259%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9594438362611393%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">29.2</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Assignments </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">and </font><font style="color:#343434;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">transfers </font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">by Obligors</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.253%;text-indent:0.014%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">No Obligor may assign its rights or novate its obligations or otherwise deal with its rights and obligations under any Finance Document without NAB's prior written consent.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.259%;display:flex;margin-top:9.6pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9594438362611393%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">29.3</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Additional Borrowers</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:6.398%;display:flex;margin-top:10.7pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.398%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.1345270400205125%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">A Borrower may request that any of its wholly-owned Subsidiaries becomes an Additional Borrower. That Subsidiary may become an Additional Borrower only if:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.15pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:1.731%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.457768218341488%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">NAB approves the addition of that Subsidiary;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.13%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.13%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.450873483921219%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	the Borrower delivers to NAB an Accession Letter, duly completed and executed by the Borrower and the Subsidiary, whereby the Subsidiary accedes as both an Additional Borrower and (unless the Subsidiary is already a Cross&shy; Guarantor) an Additional Cross&shy; Guarantor;</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.95pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:6.067%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.843%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Delivery of an Accession Letter constitutes confirmation by the proposed Additional Obligor that the representations and warranties in this document are true and correct in relation to it as at the date of delivery as if made by reference to the facts and circumstances then existing.</font></p>

  <p style="margin-left:6.067%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.528%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">For each Accession Letter or Resignation Letter, each Obligor for valuable consideration irrevocably appoints each Borrower to execute the Accession Letter or Resignation Letter on its behalf.</font></p>

  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.267%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.417%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">delay in exercising, a right or remedy under or in connection with a Finance Document, where:</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.667%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.267531553061421%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">there is no breach of a legal duty of care owed by NAB or by any of NAB's employees or agents; or</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.259%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.796%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.128396326047301%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">such loss or damage is not a reasonably foreseeable result of any such breach.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.25pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.259%;display:flex;margin-top:0.05pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:3.9594438362611393%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">36.9</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Rights and obligations are unaffected</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.227%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.417%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Rights given to NAB, and an Obligor's obligations, under or in connection with a Finance Document, are not affected by any act or omission or any other thing which might otherwise affect them under law or otherwise.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.259%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.005668041047257%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">36.10</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Inconsistent law</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.2%;text-indent:-0.03%;padding-left:0.027%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.102%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">The Obligors may have statutory rights and protections available to them under Australian &middot; laws, including laws to protect small businesses from unfair contract terms.</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:6.2%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.417%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">However, to the extent permitted by law, each Finance Document prevails to the extent it is inconsistent with any law.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.269%;display:flex;margin-top:9.1pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.731%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.864055417421289%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">36.11</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Entire agreement</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.187%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.4pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.102%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">This document constitutes the entire agreement of the parties about its subject matter and supersedes all previous agreements, understandings and negotiations on the subject matter.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.13%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.9977521201593955%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">36.12</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Telephone recording</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.133%;text-indent:0.015%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.2pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.417%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Each Obligor consents to NAB recording any telephone conversations between it and NAB in relation to any Facility that are customarily recorded in the finance industry or where the Obligor is notified prior to the commencement of the telephone conversation and such recordings being used for training and quality purposes and in any arbitral or legal proceedings.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.731%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:5.864055417421289%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">36.13</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Reinstating avoided transaction</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:6.093%;text-indent:0.03%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:10.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.102%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Each Obligor agrees that if a payment or other transaction relating to the Amount Owing is void, voidable, unenforceable or defective for any reason or a related claim is upheld, conceded or settled (each an </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Avoidance), </font><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">then even though NAB knew or should have known of the Avoidance:</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.35pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6.398%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.25531914893617%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#212121;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">each right, power and remedy of NAB, and each Obligor's liability under each</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.12in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f21;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">144</font></p></div>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <p style="margin-left:9.827%;text-indent:0.444%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:4.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Finance Document will be what it would have been, and will continue, as if the payment or transaction the subject of the Avoidance had not occurred; and</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.05pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:6.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:3.463%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.267531553061421%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">it will immediately execute and do anything necessary or reasonably required by NAB to restore NAB to its position immediately before the Avoidance (including reinstating any Finance Document) and procure that each relevant Obligor does so.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.95pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:6.333%;text-indent:0.014%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">This clause 36.13 survives any termination or full or partial discharge or release of any Finance Document.</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:2.398%;display:flex;margin-top:9.75pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:5.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:6.014221020061065%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">36.14</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:9.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">Reading down and severance</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:6.398%;display:flex;margin-top:10.65pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:2.537%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.1345270400205125%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	If any law making unfair contract terms void could apply to a term in this document, the following rules apply to interpreting that term:</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.3pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.269%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.457768218341488%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(i)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">If the law would make the term void because the term permits NAB to exercise a right or discretion in a way or to an extent that would cause detriment to an Obligor, the term shall be read down and construed so as not to permit NAB to exercise the right or discretion in such a way or to such an extent but otherwise the term shall be construed as permitting NAB to exercise the right or discretion in all ways and to any</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:13.065%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:1.333%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:1.5333294990510151%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">extent consistent with the term.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.269%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.464186067275284%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(ii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">If the law would make the term void because the term imposed a particular amount for a fee or charge, the term shall be read down and construed as authorising the maximum amount for that fee or charge which would not cause the term to be void.</font></div></div>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.45pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:10.398%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.667%;min-width:4%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.464186067275284%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(iii)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">If the law would make the term void because it authorised NAB to recover costs or losses or damages to be calculated by NAB in a specified way or in a way NAB chooses, the term shall be read down and construed as authorising NAB to recover the maximum reasonable costs, losses and damages to be calculated in a reasonable way that did not cause the term to be void.</font></div></div>
  <div style="margin-left:9.731%;display:flex;margin-top:5pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.287186077169349%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(iv)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#xe;</font></div></div>
  <div style="flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:1.12in;min-height:0.19in;justify-content:flex-end;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:1pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.75pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="margin-left:3pt;font-size:10pt;margin-top:5.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f21;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">145</font></p></div>
  <hr style="page-break-after:always;">
  <div style="min-height:1.33in;"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>
  <div style="margin-left:9.731%;display:flex;margin-top:5pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.287186077169349%;visibility:hidden;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;"></font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">If, despite the application of rules (i),</font></div></div>
  <p style="margin-left:13.64%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.463%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">(ii) and (iii) to the term, the law would make the term void, the term is to be read down and construed as if it were varied, to the minimum extent necessary, so that the term is not void.</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0.55pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <p style="margin-left:5.32%;text-indent:-0.535%;padding-left:0.48%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:4.463%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">,These reading-down rules apply before the following additional reading-down and severance provision:</font></p>
  <p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:1.1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
  <div style="margin-left:5.861%;display:flex;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:6%;min-width:3.87%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:4.110942329958891%;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="width:100%;display:inline;"><font style="color:#1f1f1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;min-width:fit-content;">	If a provision of this document is void or voidable or unenforceable by NAB, but would not be void or voidable or unenforceable if it were read down, it shall be read down accordingly.</font></div></div>
